comment: Independent C-first pickup.c do_loot_cont BAG_OF_TRICKS branch2150-2159. Wish a charged bag, drop it under an ordinary human Barbarian, and use #loot on the actual floor container. C carefully opens the bag, exposes teeth, bites with rnd(10), and sets discovery/abort_looting. Prior makemon.c bagotricks empty-charge application bite uses doapply, not floor do_loot_cont; its implementation does not wire this existing caller. Require actual charged-bag inventory, drop and floor loot before comparison.
